description: Add a skill (an Agent Skills folder as text files) to your Besidka account. The files go through the same checks as an import: paths, text only, license and content scan. A skill with a restricted license is refused. The skill is saved disabled with status needs-review and has no command and no mode: this tool cannot switch it on, set it to Auto, give it a command or give it permissions, the user does that in Besidka. The skill is saved disabled. The user must review and enable it in Besidka at the reviewUrl in the result, which also lists the findings of the scan. At most 30 skill changes an hour. Requires signing in (skills:write).

argumentHint.description: A short hint for the arguments, such as [file]

files.description: 1 to 50 text files, at most 400 KiB in all. Must include SKILL.md with a name and a description in its frontmatter

path.description: A relative path such as SKILL.md or references/guide.md

name: create_skill
title: Add a skill
